notes.title: Demo Version Update Announcement
notes.content:
Update Details

Enhanced Heroine Visuals & CG Illustrations
We’ve adjusted Chihiro’s facial expressions and variations to make her visuals even cuter and more appealing.
Some event CGs have also been refined, with updated coloring and backgrounds to further enhance the world’s charm.

New Events & Partial Spine Animation Introduced

Small events have been added to the nurturing part of the game.
Partial Spine animations have been implemented in certain scenes, bringing Chihiro’s movements and expressions to life.
Bug Fixes

Fixed a bug where an error occurred when clicking the status command.
Other minor bugs have been addressed, improving the overall stability of the demo version.
Core Content Remains Unchanged
The story structure hasn’t changed significantly from the previous demo version, but we’ve made visual and usability improvements for a smoother experience.
If you’ve already played the previous version, we encourage you to check out the updated visuals and fixes.

How to Access the Demo Version
Simply click the “Download Demo” button on the Steam store page.
If you already have the old version, Steam will automatically update it, or you can manually re-download it.

Future Schedule
We are making final adjustments, aiming for the full game’s release on January 27, 2025.
Post-release updates and additional outfits are also under consideration, so stay tuned!

Thank you for your continued support.
We hope you’ll enjoy the updated demo version and have even more fun nurturing the heroine who hatched from the egg!
Please feel free to share your feedback and thoughts on the community hub or social media!

notes.title: Demo Version Update! Heroine’s Visuals & CG Illustrations Enhanced
notes.content:
Update Details
Hello, everyone!
We’re excited to announce the release of the latest demo version. Here’s what’s new and updated:

Enhanced Heroine Visuals & CG Illustrations
Chihiro’s facial expressions and standing portraits have been slightly adjusted to make her even cuter and more appealing. We’ve also improved the coloring and backgrounds of some event CGs to enhance the visual quality.

New Events & Partial Spine Animation
We’ve added small events that occur during the nurturing part. Partial Spine animations are now introduced, making the heroine’s movements more lively.

Bug Fixes

Fixed an issue where clicking the status command caused an error, preventing it from opening.
Other minor adjustments and bug fixes were made to improve overall stability.
No Major Changes to Game Content
The core story structure and nurturing elements remain unchanged in this update. It focuses primarily on visual improvements and bug fixes, so those who’ve already played the previous version can enjoy it with enhanced visuals and smoother gameplay.

How to Download the Demo Version
Download the latest version from the “Download Demo” button on the Steam store page.
If you already have the previous version, it will update automatically or require a re-download.

Future Plans
We are continuing the final touches and aiming for a January 27 release.
Even after the release, updates and additional content are being considered, so stay tuned!

Thank you for your continued support. Enjoy the updated demo version and the enriched nurturing life with the heroine!
We’d love to hear your feedback and thoughts on the community hub or social media.
